turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm good, thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it okay to paint over wallpaper?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can, but it's a bit of a gamble. If the paper is firmly stuck, it can work. If it's loose, the paint can make it bubble.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Different question. I burned the rice. Again. Guests arrive in forty minutes.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Don't panic, there's time. You can start a fresh pot, or switch to couscous, which is ready in five minutes. Which do you prefer?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Um, my roommate, sorry. I'll be right with you again after.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure, go ahead.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are we done with the paint or should I keep it?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Keep it, we'll need touch-ups.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nina, did you pay the electric bill this month or was it my turn?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I paid it last month, so it's yours.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right. How much was it again?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Around ninety, I think. It went up because of the heater.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'll send you half of the internet too while I'm at it.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Thanks, no rush.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nina, what time is it?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's almost seven.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's sorted. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Still about the burned rice. Fresh pot or couscous?
